# A13-S24: Approval

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

I just got somewhat confused, because I saw this picture being shared – and I had not seen or approved it before. [████] wrote to me and sent some pictures and asked if it was the right direction, and he has not included any of what I answered.

We have to remember that I am hired as artist in residence, and that means all visual material from the party is presented as if it is “me” who made it….
